title: DevPass Developer Record Reference Schema
description: Non-normative public reference interface for representing a DevPass developer record.

developer_record_id.description: Unique identifier for the developer record.

subject_reference.description: Public or implementation-defined reference to the developer associated with the record.

status.description: Simplified public reference status. This vocabulary is non-normative.

credential_references.description: Optional references to credentials associated with the record.

authorship_references.description: Optional references to authorship or contribution evidence.

attestation_references.description: Optional references to third-party attestations associated with the record.

skill_references.description: Optional references to skills or skill evidence.

updated_at.description: Timestamp at which this public record representation was last updated.

metadata.description: Optional implementation-specific metadata. Consumers should not treat metadata as normative verification semantics.
